_context.coworker.failed: A system note shown in a thread when a coworker (an AI teammate) was asked to answer and could not. {name} is the coworker's name.
_context.list.unread: Accessible label of the unread counter next to a channel name.
_context.composer.placeholder: Placeholder of the message box. {name} is the channel name, written after a # sign.
_context.message.edited: Small marker after a message that was changed after it was sent.

title: Channels
description: Conversations your team and coworkers share.

list.label: Channels and direct messages
list.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
list.noDirectMessages: No conversation yet. Write to a teammate or a coworker.
list.loadFailed: The channels could not be loaded.

channel.selectDescription: Open a channel or a direct message from the list, or start a new one.
channel.emptyDescription: Say hello. Mention a coworker with @ and it answers in the thread.
channel.dmEmptyDescription: Messages here stay between the two of you.
channel.dmCoworkerEmptyDescription: Ask {name} anything: it answers right here.
channel.notFoundDescription: It may be private, archived, or gone.
channel.loadFailed: This conversation could not be loaded.
channel.archived: This channel is archived. Its messages stay readable, nobody can post any more.
channel.preview: You are reading #{name} without being a member.

message.deleteDescription: The message is removed for everyone in this conversation. Replies in its thread stay. This cannot be undone.

failed.engine_unreachable: {name} could not answer: your workspace's machine cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
failed.engine_outdated: {name} could not answer: your workspace's machine needs an update before coworkers can answer in channels.
failed.coworker_disabled: {name} could not answer: this coworker is switched off.
failed.no_model: {name} could not answer: it has no AI model it can use. Connect one in its settings.
failed.no_access: {name} could not answer: you do not have access to its Box.
failed.not_member: {name} could not answer: it is not a member of this channel.
failed.timeout: {name} took too long to answer and stopped.

coworker.outsider: {name} is not in this channel yet, so it cannot answer.
coworker.outsiderManagerOnly: {name} is not in this channel. Ask whoever manages it to add this coworker.
coworker.addFailed: The coworker could not be added.

thread.title: Thread
thread.replies: {count, plural, =0 {No reply yet} one {# reply} other {# replies}}
thread.gone: This thread is no longer available.

details.title: Details
details.removeDescription: {name} stops seeing this channel and its messages. You can add them back later.
details.leaveDescription: It leaves your list. You can join a public channel again from Browse channels; a private one needs a member to add you back.
details.archiveDescription: Nobody can post in it any more and it leaves everyone's list. Its messages are kept. This cannot be undone from here.

create.title: New channel
create.description: A channel gathers people and coworkers around one topic.
create.name: Name
create.privateHint: Only the members you add can find and read it.
create.editDescription: Rename the channel or say what it is for.

browse.title: Browse channels
browse.description: The public channels of your workspace.

picker.dmDescription: Write to a teammate or a coworker.
picker.addDescription: The people and coworkers you add can read and post here.
